title: Exact small-instance oracle
summary: Exact corpus built; a six-leaf counterexample refutes endpoint-only branching even with two off-path subtrees.

claims.label: Frozen controls
claims.detail: 15/15 hand controls, invalid forests, and malformed inputs passed. Exact Python checks; not Lean.

claims.label: Complete small corpus
claims.detail: 11259 ordered tree pairs enumerated on leaf counts [3, 4, 5]; witnesses retained. Finite corpus only.

claims.label: Contract any equal restriction
claims.detail: Conflicting triples: equal two-leaf restriction; deletion reduces optimum from two to one.

claims.label: Drop side branch when t≥2
claims.detail: Survived n≤5, then a fresh six-leaf sampled pair refuted it. Unique optimum {{a},{b},{c,d,e,f}} retains both cherry endpoints d,f together.

claims.label: Six-leaf cherry search
claims.detail: 2000 exact sampled pairs; 2200 eligible cherries. refuted-by-exact-enumeration; not Lean.

example.caption: Unique optimum: three components. Cherry endpoints d and f stay together; dropping the side-subtree branch fails.
